releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **commands**: register quality-audit and quality-assurance commands
- **commands**: register quality-audit and quality-assurance commands
- **commands**: add quality-assurance builtin template
- **commands**: add quality-audit builtin template
- **crypto-market**: add market-data domain skills, agents, tools, and hooks
- **skills**: add ZeroMQ expertise family (pyzmq-first)

### Bug Fixes

- **agents**: forbid prose-summary substitute when DCP compress unavailable

### Documentation

- rewrite README as product landing page

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #167 from klpanagi/feat/quality-commands
- Merge pull request #166 from klpanagi/fix/dcp-compress-no-substitute-165
- Merge pull request #164 from klpanagi/feat/crypto-market-extension
- Merge pull request #163 from klpanagi/feat/zeromq-skills
- Merge pull request #162 from klpanagi/docs/readme-landing-page

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx/compare/v2.6.16...v2.6.17

## What's Changed

### Features

- **context-mode**: upstream-optimal routing — throttle, WebFetch deny, system.transform injection, prompt shrink
- **plan**: raise default plan file cap to 140000 bytes
- **plan**: growth guards, trim enforcement, and contract slimming
- **plan**: make plan file size cap configurable via plans.max_plan_file_bytes
- **session-cleanup**: add opt-in tool to delete leaked sessions

### Bug Fixes

- **oracle**: stop the Smith loop on convergence, not a fixed round cap
- **background-agent**: stop prune TTL from killing running tasks
- **evolution**: stop leaking a top-level session per compression

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #161 from klpanagi/fix/agents-plan-directive
- Fix stale Read+Edit plan directive in AGENTS.md
- Merge pull request #160 from klpanagi/feat/context-mode-upstream-optimal
- Merge pull request #159 from klpanagi/fix/158-tool-entry
- Add side-effect-free tool entry for sandbox/bench use (fixes #158)
- Merge pull request #157 from klpanagi/perf/cache-session-transcript-fetches
- perf: drop the mission-state read cache as unmeasurable
- perf: cache session transcript fetches and mission state reads
- Merge pull request #154 from klpanagi/feat/plan-growth-guards
- Merge origin/dev into feat/plan-growth-guards
- Merge pull request #153 from klpanagi/feat/plans-max-cap-config
- Merge pull request #152 from klpanagi/fix/background-prune-ttl-running-tasks
- Merge pull request #151 from klpanagi/fix/evolution-compressor-session-leak

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx/compare/v2.6.15...v2.6.16

## What's Changed

### Features

- **plan-review**: add the post-execution completion review pipeline
- **agents**: add the auditor post-execution plan reviewer
- **plan**: add section-scoped plan_update edits with a hash staleness gate
- **plan**: address plans by section and make the byte cap a ceiling

### Bug Fixes

- **hashline**: widen the per-line anchor from 8 bits to 32 bits
- **plan**: report non-kebab plan filenames instead of silently skipping them
- **plan**: reject misplaced section fields instead of silently ungating a write

### Refactoring

- **plan**: unify the byte ruler and add the section registry

### Documentation

- **agents**: teach the orchestrators the new plan contract

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #150 from klpanagi/feat/remove-dcp-base
- Remove dcp.base, allow per-profile overrides by profile name
- Merge pull request #149 from klpanagi/test/fix-cwd-coupling-and-loc-convention
- Merge pull request #148 from klpanagi/feat/plan-completion-review
- changes default dcp brutal profile parameters
- Merge pull request #147 from klpanagi/feat/plan-section-addressing

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx/compare/v2.6.14...v2.6.15

## What's Changed

### Features

- **hooks**: register and dispatch task-notepad-writer in the tool-guard tier
- **hooks**: add task-notepad-writer hook with two-bucket flat notepad layout
- **task**: batch support in task_create, one response envelope
- **task**: add a real priority field to task_create and task_update
- **tasks**: scope background gates to a durable parentID ancestry walk
- **tasks**: separate background staleness window from the enforcer window
- **tasks**: add session-scoped pending-work predicate

### Bug Fixes

- **tasks**: reclaim terminal+stale tasks, stop unattributed task adoption, harden closure directives
- **agents**: correct eight invalid task_create examples
- **ultrawork**: make the goal-registration line capability-safe
- **agents**: derive task-store permission from agent mode, not a name list
- **background-agent**: bound the completion gate to a 2h staleness window
- **session-manager**: report stale-but-incomplete work in include_todos
- **plan-persister**: stop skipping the metadata stamp on a zero-vote sync
- **background-agent**: thread pluginConfig to the task-store completion gates
- **session-manager**: thread pluginConfig to the include_todos task read
- **session-notification**: thread pluginConfig to the skipIfIncompleteTodos predicate

### Refactoring

- **agents**: require Seraph to verify capability-gap premises
- **session-manager**: read task state for the include_todos diagnostic
- **hooks**: delete the legacy session todo probe
- **background-agent**: gate completion on the task store
- **background-agent**: inject task-store probe into reconcile
- **session-notification**: back idle suppression with the task store
- **plan-persister**: drop legacy session todo fallback
- **prompts**: drop todowrite from skills, commands, ultrawork detectors
- **agents**: collapse useTaskSystem prompt fork to task-system-only
- refactor(hooks)!: remove legacy todowrite modules
- **hooks**: register task-continuation-enforcer unconditionally, drop todo wiring
- **tools**: make todowrite/todoread suppression unconditional
- **tasks**: make task system unconditional, warn on legacy keys
- **config**: retain 4 legacy todo hook names + task_system keys as deprecated no-ops

### Documentation

- remove vendor-specific model names from docs and README
- correct legacy task-notepad row and document task-notepad-writer
- **hooks**: update hook counts and index tables for task-notepad-writer
- state the task-store eligibility policy
- **todo**: prune dead hook refs and recount agent tool grants
- **tasks**: document the two staleness windows and the ancestry scope
- **todo**: state that all session todo reads were removed
- purge legacy todo refs, split task-system docs, regen schema, assert pre-existing drift

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #146 from klpanagi/chore/remove-repo-pr-template
- Merge pull request #145 from klpanagi/fix/task-lifecycle-reclaim-and-closure-directives
- Merge pull request #144 from klpanagi/docs/remove-vendor-model-references
- Merge pull request #143 from klpanagi/feat/task-notepad-writer
- Merge pull request #142 from klpanagi/fix/task-store-eligibility
- Merge pull request #140 from klpanagi/remove/legacy-todo-system

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx/compare/v2.6.13...v2.6.14

## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

- **dcp**: harden DeepSeek DCP echo loop

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #135 from klpanagi/test/relocate-src-tests
- Merge pull request #134 from klpanagi/fix/dcp-loop-hardening

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx/compare/v2.6.12...v2.6.13
